summary: Every requirement and ruling the plan states has implementing work I can point at: R1 in cicd.writeVersionPins (P2), R5/R6/R7 in KubeCoderDeploy's stage-file pins, chart required-guards and rewritten render gate (P1), R8 and Ruling 5 in design.md's three sites, D45/D37's amendments and slice 012's carried-in section (P3); R2/R4 left the slice under Ruling 1 and R3 is discharged as evidence, not a change (G4). V04 — Ruling 2's library-load canary — is the only unimplemented criterion and is the test phase's to prepare, which runs after this consult. The three advisory findings the P3 review left do not clear the bar: S5 is plan-described but its three constraints are already stated in the method's own docstring, which is what the author of the slice-012 call reads, and Ruling 5's enumerated handoff all landed; S6's contradiction is Ruling 1's own staging against G5, and both texts now sit in slice 012's slice.md for its planner to settle; both are noted in the close-out rather than bought with an executor round, a review round and another consult. B4's two false absolutes in the register were mechanical prose residue in files this slice already touched — fixed and committed here (AnsibleSpecs a4fd09c), B4 struck, with S2 and B1's stale build-511 numbers noted against Ruling 4's 523.
